lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno spilled a glass of milk,
He cried a river, smooth as silk!
Kiki said, don't fret, don't frown,
Just wipe it up and calm right down!
[chorus]
Don't cry over spilled milk, don't cry over spilled milk,
What's done is done, smooth as silk!
Don't cry over spilled milk, don't cry over spilled milk,
Wipe it up and pour more milk!
[verse]
It means don't be upset for long
About a thing that's already gone,
You can't undo it, so move on,
Learn a little, then sing a song!
[chorus]
Don't cry over spilled milk, don't cry over spilled milk,
What's done is done, smooth as silk!
Don't cry over spilled milk, don't cry over spilled milk,
Smile again, as soft as silk!
[outro]
So when a little thing goes wrong,
Don't cry over spilled milk, move along!
